text:
Mikael Backlund is 37, the Flames' captain, and stuck on 2 goals in 15 games. He has taken 40 shots and is shooting 5 percent against a league average around 13.5. On 3.99 expected goals, he should have about two more. Calgary has also scored 3.27 fewer goals than its chances with him on the ice.

His value has never been mostly in the points. Evolving-Hockey had him at 88th percentile among forwards at taking chances away last season, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 97th percentile for primary shot assists. He is still playing over 18 minutes a night, a little more than his season average lately.

The honest worry is age: he was around replacement level in wins last season. But a center who takes chances away and keeps getting to the net is not done because his shooting percentage is cold for a month. Watch whether the shots keep coming. If they do, the goals will.
headline: Backlund's chances aren't going in, and his work isn't changing
